units.source_text: “夫人的态度自然影响了我的情绪，

en.t: Madam's attitude naturally affected my mood,

units.source_text: 过了不久，我的眼神就不那么不安定了。

en.t: Before long, my eyes were no longer so restless.

units.source_text: 我感觉自己的心回到了坐着看书的自己身上了。

en.t: I felt that my mind had returned to the self sitting there reading.

units.source_text: 总之，夫人和家人对我那乖僻的目光和充满猜忌的样子，并没有放在心上，这使我感到了莫大的幸福吧。

en.t: In short, the fact that Madam and the household paid no mind to my perverse looks and suspicious manner probably brought me immense happiness.

units.source_text: 我的神经由于没有受到别人的不良反应的刺激，而逐渐平静下来了。

en.t: Because my nerves were not provoked by any adverse reaction from others, they gradually settled down.

units.source_text: 我觉得夫人是个有教养的人，所以才会特意这样对待我，

en.t: I thought that Madam treated me deliberately in this way because she was a person of good breeding,

units.source_text: 可又觉得或许像她所说的那样，真的认为我是个大方的人。

en.t: but I also thought that perhaps, just as she said, she truly regarded me as broad-minded.

units.source_text: 此外，也不排除由于我的疑神疑鬼只限于我的脑子里，并没有显露出来的关系，因而夫人被我蒙蔽了的可能性。

en.t: Besides, it was also possible that Madam had been misled because my suspicions remained only inside my head and had not shown themselves outwardly.

units.source_text: 随着心情逐渐平静，我开始和她们亲近起来。

en.t: As my feelings gradually calmed, I began to grow closer to them.

units.source_text: 无论和夫人还是和小姐，我都可以谈笑风生了。

en.t: I became able to talk and laugh freely with both Madam and the young lady.

units.source_text: 有时候，我被叫到她们的房间喝茶，也有时候，我买来点心，晚上请她们来我房间坐坐。

en.t: Sometimes I was called to their room for tea, and at other times I bought sweets and invited them to sit in my room in the evening.

units.source_text: 我突然感觉交际范围扩大了，也因此常常影响到了我宝贵的学习时间，

en.t: I suddenly felt that my circle of social contact had widened, and this often cut into my precious study time,

units.source_text: 奇怪的是，这些对我竟完全不构成干扰。

en.t: but strangely enough, none of it felt like an interference to me at all.
Madam, of course, had nothing in particular to do.

units.source_text: 小姐不但要上学，还正在学习插花和古琴，想必很忙，

en.t: The young lady had school, and was also learning flower arrangement and the koto, so I expected she must be busy,

units.source_text: 谁知，她也好像时间多得没处打发似的，

en.t: but unexpectedly, she too seemed to have more time than she knew what to do with,

units.source_text: 结果，三个人只要一碰面，就凑在一起，聊天消遣。

en.t: and as a result, whenever the three of us met, we gathered together and passed the time chatting.
